$comment: Synthetic run history for the Thanksgiving example, generated by rhylthyme_cli_runner.history.synthesize_runs with a known generating law so prediction can be tested against truth. Read by rhylthyme-cli-runner/tests/test_predict.py and by rhylthyme-server/mcp-api/{history,schedule}.test.js. To regenerate, call synthesize_runs(program, 20, ...) with exactly the arguments in `generator` below and the `law` as duration_fn, then set context.userId as `generator.userIds` describes.
law: turkey-roast duration = 600 + 90 * turkeyKg seconds (x lognormal noise, CV 0.05)

generator.factors: turkeyKg = 5 + i % 4, oven = gas when i % 5 < 3 else convection
generator.userIds: context.userId = cook-1 on even runs, another cook otherwise
